triage.title: Check ya sickness
triage.disclaimer: Dis check no be doctor. If na emergency, call 15 or go for hospital wey dey near.

recommendation.RED: Go emergency now now. Go for hospital wey dey near and get emergency unit.
recommendation.AMBER: Go see doctor today. Go for clinic or hospital wey dey near you.
recommendation.GREEN: E no too serious. Rest and watch am. If e worse or pass 3 days, go for clinic.

questions.age: How old the sick person be?
questions.age_months: How many months (for pikin wey never reach 5 years)
questions.symptoms: Wetin the sick person dey feel?
questions.resp_rate: How many times e dey breathe for one minute (if you count am)

symptoms.chest_pain: Chest dey pain or dey press
symptoms.stroke_symptoms: Face, hand or talk change sudden (stroke)
symptoms.difficulty_breathing: E hard well well for breathe
symptoms.severe_bleeding: Blood dey comot plenty and e no wan stop
symptoms.dehydration: Body don dry (no water for body)
symptoms.weakness_one_side: One side of body weak or no get feeling
symptoms.unable_walk: E no fit waka or stand up alone
symptoms.unconscious: E no dey wake or answer
symptoms.unable_feed: Pikin no fit suck or drink
symptoms.chest_indraw: Chest dey enter inside when e breathe
symptoms.ear_discharge: Water dey comot for ear pass 2 weeks
symptoms.palmar_pallor: Hand palm don white (no blood for body)
symptoms.ob_haemorrhage: Blood dey comot for woman side
symptoms.ob_prolonged_labour: Labour don too long or e don block
symptoms.ob_no_fetal_movement: Pikin for belle never move pass 12 hours
symptoms.ob_severe_headache: Strong headache and eye no dey see well
symptoms.ob_difficulty_breathing: E hard for breathe when woman get belle

first_aid.title: First-aid:
first_aid.burns: - Fire burn: pour cold water 10 min

ussd.triage_q1:
Check ya sickness:
Q1: How many years the sick person get? (put number)

triage_q2.prompt: Q2: Wetin be the main sickness? Reply:

triage_done.RED: URGENT: Go emergency for hospital wey dey near now now or call 15.
triage_done.AMBER: Go see doctor today. Type MENU for find clinic wey dey near.
triage_done.GREEN: Ya sickness no look serious. Rest, drink water. Type MENU for more.

ussd.facility_prompt: Send the name of ya quarter (e.g. Molyko) for find hospital wey dey near.
ussd.facility_searching: We dey find hospital near {area}. Reply MENU for continue.
ussd.callback_confirm: Type YES make nurse call you back.
ussd.callback_done: Nurse go call you soon. Take care.

common.offline: Network no dey. We go send am when network come back.
common.error_generic: Something no work. Abeg try again.

consultation.complaint_label: Tell we wetin dey worry you
consultation.anonymous_notice: You dey talk with doctor without ya name. Doctor no go see ya name or ya phone number.
